sn26.6:1.1: sāvatthiyaṃ: yo bhikkhave, cakkhusamphassajāya vedanāya uppādo ṭhiti …pe… yo manosamphassajāya vedanāya uppādo ṭhiti …pe… jarāmaraṇassa pātubhāvo. yo ca kho bhikkhave, cakkhusamphassajāya vedanāya nirodho vūpasamo …pe… yo manosamphassajāya vedanāya nirodho vūpasamo …pe… jarāmaraṇassa atthagamoti. 5. 1. 6. saññā suttaṃ sāvatthiyaṃ:
sn26.6:1.4: yo dhammasaññāya uppādo ṭhiti …pe… jarāmaraṇassa pātubhāvo.
sn26.6:1.5: yo ca kho bhikkhave, rūpasaññāya nirodho vūpasamo
sn26.6:1.7: yo dhammasaññāya nirodho vūpasamo …pe… jarāmaraṇassa atthagamoti.
